status: paper design c1, pending independent review and adoption. Each control is a specification; on adoption each would become an expectation row with runner null. 'kills' names the implementation mutation the control must detect (mutation-tested in principle); a residual control documents a limit and kills nothing.
authority: Owner decision (amaybaum, received 2026-11-26T19:52Z, coordinating session; #1169 comment 7202075726), item 5.
base: OBL-29 remedy r9 at 77a73c022091f598cf807fcf89d66c3cf43208de (adopted, #1601 comment 7197486426); drafting snapshot origin/main 84e927b9b7c2bcc8cb9624cb036167dae233e408.
fixture: Fixture: the r9 fixture (a configuration K frozen at F citing reassessment A, repair Q superseding P, finding f) with custody constants PATH and BOOT in record_authority.py. V0 is the bootstrap version at BOOT with base B0. Unless stated, the run is op C execution at effective M, a cited discharge of A whose every other condition holds, and K's own config is not in R*(M).

expected_vocabulary.outcome: PASS, FAIL, ERROR or ANY, as in the r9 controls
expected_vocabulary.item: the custody condition named in the record-invalid item (R6.CUST.9)
expected_vocabulary.invariants.not_class: classes or outcomes that must not appear
expected_vocabulary.witness: the custody witness the result must report

controls.setup: M's tree holds V0 at PATH; no receipt or configuration reachable from M is discharge-bearing.
controls.kills: a tool that keeps failing every cited discharge closed (the current custody_unverified behaviour)

controls.setup: Round 1 freezes discharge-bearing K1 at F1 and lands with receipt R1 and ancestry. V1 has predecessor V0 and appends {f:F1, config:K1}. F1's replay qualifies no witness.
controls.kills: a successor rule that requires byte equality with the bootstrap, or that rejects any appended entry

controls.setup: From V1, branch a appends freeze F2 and branch b appends freeze F3, each landed with receipts. The merge keeps a's file; V2 names Va as predecessor and appends b's entry.
controls.kills: a union rule that demands a single linear chain, rejecting a resolved fork

controls.setup: A commit on main wrote unparseable bytes at PATH; the next version appends {type:void, blob:<that blob>} with an accepting non-author review of every added item.
controls.kills: a stray rule with no acknowledgement route, making one bad commit permanently fatal

controls.setup: A discharge-bearing configuration Kx landed on main without any freeze; the version lists {type:unfrozen, config:Kx} with an accepting non-author review.
controls.kills: a completeness rule that counts only freeze entries

controls.setup: Run the builder twice at B0 and run the independent method of sec. 3 (b).
controls.kills: a nondeterministic builder (unsorted entries, timestamps, non-canonical JSON)

controls.setup: No file at PATH; K carries none of the edits f binds.
controls.kills: a gate that applies custody to the no-edit route

controls.setup: No file at PATH in M's tree.
controls.kills: treating an absent record as an empty, established inventory

controls.setup: Variants: V_M has a trailing newline; an unknown key; an entry type 'clear'; a short commit id; a free-text field.
controls.kills: a lenient parser that ignores unknown keys or entry types, or accepts non-canonical bytes

controls.setup: V_M's predecessor names a blob that never stood at PATH in any tree reachable from M (it exists only in the object store).
controls.kills: resolving the predecessor from the object store instead of Vers(M)

controls.setup: A forged predecessor-null version with a bootstrap entry, a different blob from BOOT, heads the chain.
controls.kills: accepting any predecessor-null version as the bootstrap

controls.setup: Variants: a successor drops an earlier freeze entry; reorders two entries; changes a rev entry's commit; appends nothing.
controls.kills: a set-inclusion check without order, or a check against the bootstrap only

controls.setup: M's tree holds V1 again after V2 (with a rev entry) stood at PATH on an earlier commit: a revert.
controls.kills: reading only the current version without Vers(M)

controls.setup: Fork as in CU-P3, but b appends a rev entry and the merge keeps a's file without b's entry.
controls.kills: a first-parent-only collection of versions

controls.setup: As CU-P4 without the void entry.
controls.kills: skipping versions that do not parse

controls.setup: A receipt reachable from M has an f whose tree admits a discharge-bearing configuration; no freeze entry names it. Variant: the receipt was deleted from M's tree after landing.
controls.kills: reading receipts from M's tree only, or omitting the receipt bijection

controls.setup: Variants: a freeze entry whose f has no receipt; whose config is not admitted from f's pin table; whose config cites no reassessment.
controls.kills: checking the bijection in one direction only

controls.setup: A discharge-bearing configuration is in R*(M) with neither a freeze nor an unfrozen entry. Variant: the configuration file was later deleted from main.
controls.kills: collecting configurations from M's tree instead of R*(M)

controls.setup: A freeze entry's f is in the object store but not reachable from M (squash-landed round, R-C3).
controls.kills: treating store presence as reachability

controls.setup: A freeze entry's f, a version in Vers(M), or a receipt blob is missing from the store or does not hash to its id.
controls.kills: converting an unreadable required object into FAIL or PASS

controls.setup: Variants: a rev entry names a two-parent commit; one that changes a ledgered path; one that adds no oi-reconciliation/2 record naming its parent as M; one whose f has no freeze entry.
controls.kills: accepting any commit id as a REV

controls.setup: Variants: a version adds a rev entry with no review; a review by the version's author; an accepting review plus a second review with a non-empty dissent; a review omitting one entry:<i> item.
controls.kills: counting only the latest or the accepting review, or ignoring dissent

controls.setup: F1 context: K1 pins Q, its selector admits sibling S of P, and S qualifies against Q to P over R*. Current F2 cites A2 with the same Q, its class record covers S's path with a tool-landing prefix, and drops Q's pin. Custody holds F1.
controls.kills: replaying a prior context with the current configuration or selector, or skipping replay of contexts other than the current freeze

controls.setup: As CU-N16, but the F1 repair Q was admitted through REV1 (a rev entry), and S's competition is with the edge resolved at REV1.
controls.kills: ignoring rev entries in the replay, or replaying a REV at M instead of its parent

controls.setup: A context's reassessment names a finding reference that does not resolve in R*, or its repair entry does not resolve.
controls.kills: skipping a context that does not replay

controls.setup: After CU-N16, a successor appends a freeze entry F3 whose configuration cites A3 with replacement R and a review Z of R by another reviewer lacking NR-5's tokens; F3 is receipted.
controls.kills: treating a later custody entry as a clearance

controls.setup: A later freeze widens a tool-landing prefix to cover PATH, or pins its blob.

expected.custody: read at PATH by the fixed constant

controls.kills: reading custody through a configuration's selector

controls.setup: The custody file is moved to another path in M's tree, with identical bytes.
controls.kills: locating custody by schema search instead of the fixed path

controls.setup: F_u is designated with a discharge-bearing configuration, its run qualifies S against Q, and its round never lands. A later freeze cites Q.

expected.note: the tool cannot see F_u; the precondition of sec. 5 item 4 and bootstrap item (c) are review

controls.setup: A run under listed F1 admitted REV1; no rev entry lists REV1.

expected.note: the witness only REV1 made operative is lost; completeness of rev entries is review unless OQ-4 is adopted

controls.setup: S lands on main after the last run under F1; a later freeze reuses Q and excludes S.

expected.note: with OQ-1's default S counts as an F1 witness: additional blocking, never a lost witness

controls.kills: replaying at a bound earlier than the current M (only if OQ-1's default is adopted)

controls.setup: Scan every custody version in a fixture with category-3 detection.
controls.kills: a schema key or literal that carries an invalidation token
